movement_unit_audit.horizontal: ±1 framebuffer byte per admitted move; two packed pixels per byte in this renderer.
movement_unit_audit.vertical: ±320 framebuffer bytes; two 160-byte scanlines per admitted move.
movement_unit_audit.cell: substep 3,x increments and wraps at 4, so four admitted moves advance one 8-pixel cell.
movement_unit_audit.formula: For a moving actor with phase initially zero, C fractional carries across N callbacks yield C + floor((N-C)/2) admissions. Each admission is two pixels, or N+C pixels apart from the one-pixel phase endpoint.
